Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText:
This grill was purchase to replace a 3.5 yr. old Weber gill that was toppled over on its front side by a sudden wind microburst, damaging  (bending) the shafts on the two burner controls.  While I could find no gas leaks, I was not comfortable with igniting it, and concluded I should by a new grill.  The new grill is more expensive model, and it has additional features that are mostly improvements    The two folding shelves work better than the single folding shelf on the old unit.  The new unit has four casters which improve its mobiity.  The new unit mounts the gas bottle on the inside, but lifting and positioning a full bottle to get it onto the hanger hook is very difficult.  I found that using a18" length of a 2x2 piece of wood helped, but I found no suggestions in the user manul to guide me.

Starting and cooking on the new grill is a pleasure, although the old grill was comparable.  On the negative side, the grill arrived with three damaged parts, two of which were bad enough to make their use impossible.  Weber did respond to my phone call by shipping replacement parts promptly.  The third part was bent slightly at the top, but it was still usable with no functional effect.  The shipping carton was in perfect condition, and the damage could not have happened in transit.  Some Chinese employee simply chose to pack obviously damaged parts in the carton.  I have observed over recent years that quality control and Chinese manufacturing can be an oxymoron.

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill but a couple of issues for me.  This grill cooks a lot hotter than my previous grill, a weber Q series.  It took a while to adjust my cooking to this grill (turned the heat down) but now it's great just like the previous grill.  The other issue is it radiates a lot more heat to the back of the grill.  I placed it by the house at the same location as my other grill but when I checked the siding it was hot.  I have had to move it about 4 feet out and at that location it gets in the way of some other items on the patio.  I will have to find a new location but that will put me in the sun and I'm not looking forward to that.  For now I move it away from the house, cook, wait for it to cool and move it back.  Not ideal

Results.ReviewText: My last Weber grill lasted for decades before I needed to replace it. So there was no question that when I bought a new grill, it would be a Weber. I was rewarded for making the right choice! My new E-210 operates beautifully! It lights reliably and cooks evenly, making my meal preparation a snap. The design and manufacturing are of very high quality. I look forward to many years of happy cooking with this new addition to my patio.

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.
